prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection, and custom pet style selector views were helpful.
Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, subsequent sign-in reorders, desktop diagnostic flows, playful starter hubs, carousel path layouts, and desktop overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Path decision speed helper callouts and path choice flexibility reassurance copy performed worse than the control.
Predictions were too low for photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, tests with no clear effect, and changes that worsened performance.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +10.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +9.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +8.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -2.8% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +3.7% over 2 test(s)
- finish, layout: +6.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -1.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.9% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.0% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:

- adoption: 75.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Photo Prep Screen: Insert a dedicated pre-upload guidance screen before photo submission to ensure custom pet photo uploads render accurately. (why: Support logs contain multiple tickets about custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly.)
1: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Persistence Verification Flow: Add explicit cloud save verification step to sign-in screen to ensure user account data and pet bindings persist correctly. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset after signing back into an account.)
2: [finish, copy] Desktop Visibility Actionable Prompt: Update final desktop welcome copy with explicit instructions on how to summon and interact with the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets missing from desktop on finish, and 3 tickets noted confusion on controlling the pet.)
3: [home, wait_info] Estimated Generation Time Progress Indicator: Enable live step counter and estimated remaining time readout during pet adoption background processing. (why: Home waiting duration has high mean time (2336s), leading users to think the desktop app has hung.)
4: [sign_in, incentive] Instant Sign-In Cloud Sync Badge: Add a prominent cloud protection badge component to the sign-in screen highlighting account safety. (why: 21.7% drop-off at sign-in step and 8 support tickets regarding account pet loss upon login.)
5: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout Adoption Finalization: Update adoption certificate layout to stage format to clearly delineate final pet adoption confirmation. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 75.3% with high mean completion duration.)
6: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Assistance Tooltip: Add actionable visual hint and tip carousel to photo upload step to prevent malformed custom pet models. (why: Custom pet generation failures account for multiple support tickets during adoption.)
7: [home, notification] Ready Sound Notification Prompt: Add desktop audio alert notification setting on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes. (why: Long wait times (mean 2336s) cause users to step away from their desk and miss pet spawn completion.)

scores.note: Adoption loses ~24.7% of users; photo quality callouts performed very well previously and adoption new_screen previously yielded +8.1%.

Strong support alignment, but account sync banners previously showed no clear effect.
